name: OPA827 / OPA827AID
tagline: TI's 2006 JFET single (4 nV/√Hz, 22 MHz) that DIYers treat as the modern OPA627, a DAC I/V favourite.

lineage.note: Benchmark OPA627 Difet: a different part and die (16 MHz). The OPA827 datasheet never mentions it.
Sole source; SBOS376 first issued Nov 2006. Early mirror copies labelled Burr-Brown. Dual OPA2827 stayed in preview.
Successor OPA828/OPA2828 (SBOS671D), 'next generation OPA627 and OPA827': 45 MHz, 150 V/µs, 4 nV/√Hz.

part_numbers.note: SOIC-8 tube of 75, marked 'OPA / 827 / A'. In PCN 20240628012.1. Adapter favourite.
SOIC-8 reel of 2500. ACTIVE in Oct-2013 addendum.
VSSOP-8 (DGK) reels, marked 'NSP'. AIDGKT (250) listed at Mouser.
'G4' Green duplicates of SOIC tube and reel; same marking and die.
High grade in Rev F and earlier; deleted in Rev G (Feb 2012); probably unshipped.
Dual announced as Product Preview only; apparently never released. Treat any for sale as suspect.

reputation.summary: DIYers treat it as the cheaper modern OPA627, mostly as a DAC I/V converter and in socket-rolled stages on adapters. Xonar Essence threads rank it with LT1361, LT1028 and OPA627 for I/V. Impressions conflict: neutral, clean and more dynamic than OPA627, or dark, warm and bass-centric (diyAudio). Zigsow reviews call it 'Successor to the legendary stone'. No ASR measurement found.
typical_uses: DAC I/V stage (Asus Xonar Essence ST/STX)
Portable DAC/amp swaps on DIP-8 adapters (Fostex HP-A4)
16–18-bit ADC drivers, transimpedance amps, professional audio
caveats: SMD single only; DIP-8 sockets need an adapter, dual sockets two parts on a 2-in-1 board.
Not rail-to-rail: input and output reach only within 3 V of each rail (about ±2 V on ±5 V).
Needs at least ±4 V and draws 4.8 mA; keep decoupling at the chip on adapters.
DC precision: non-symmetric INL as ADC buffer (PatrickBaus thesis); higher near-DC 1/f noise than OPA227.
JFET bias rises steeply with heat (±5 nA at 125 °C). Costs more than common audio duals.
sources: https://zigsow.jp/item/261371/review/319336%20(title:%20伝説の石の後継品%20-%20OPA827AIDのレビュー)

counterfeit_notes: No OPA827-specific fake reports. Genuine marks: SOIC 'OPA / 827 / A', VSSOP 'NSP'. TI never made DIP-8 or shipped OPA2827, so both are suspect. Buy from authorised distributors; check Iq (4.8 mA) and slew (≥20 V/µs).

silicon_changes.summary: TI PCN#20240628012.1 ('Qualification alternate Mount & Mold Compound material for select devices', 28 Jun 2024) lists OPA827AID. Samples until 28 Jul 2024; first ship 26 Sep 2024. No die, fab or datasheet change.
silicon_changes.identification: Same part number and die; no marking change documented, so post-Sep 2024 lots may use either material set. No Cu-wire PCN found.
silicon_changes.audio_impact: Negligible. Mold stress could shift precision offset slightly, but no such effect is documented.
silicon_changes.compatibility_risk: low: assembly-material change only; no datasheet, die or pinout change.
silicon_changes.verification: PCN title, dates and change type (Assembly Site/Materials) confirmed; no Cu-wire PCN lists OPA827.

silicon_changes.summary: Rev G moved from Mixed Status to Production Data, deleted the planned high grade, revised bias and drift text, set offset/drift/bias limits, and added SR and short-circuit minimums. Likely final characterisation; datasheet change only, no PCN or die change found.
silicon_changes.identification: None on the part. Pre-2012 parts were sold against Rev F (Mixed Status) and earlier specs.

spec_deltas.parameter: Input offset voltage / drift / Ib limits
spec_deltas.before: Rev F values (not retrieved); Features bullets differed
spec_deltas.after: Rev G+: 150 uV max, 2.0 uV/°C max, ±10 pA max at 25 °C

silicon_changes.audio_impact: Negligible for audio; matters only for DC-precision designs relying on preview limits or the dropped high grade.
silicon_changes.compatibility_risk: low: same pinout and packages; no known die change.
silicon_changes.verification: Rev G revision history confirms a datasheet-only respec; exact Rev F limits not retrieved.
